open_items: ILO: periodic 403 pattern, fourth occurrence. Cycles 1343-1345 and 1354-1355 (2026-11-14/15, gaps of roughly 34-46 hours), then cycle 1363 (2026-11-15 18:01Z, blanket 403 on gateway and direct), then cycle 1366 (2026-11-16 00:01Z, gateway-only 403, direct path clean) -- only 6 hours after 1363, with cycles 1364-1365 healthy in between. Live recheck at 00:44Z got a clean 200 direct, consistent with the cycle's own direct-path result. Classification is gateway_issue (ours by the monitor's mechanical rule) but the shape (clean 403, no empty-error signature) looks like ILO periodically blocking or rate-limiting the gateway's outbound IP rather than an application bug. Watch whether the recurrence interval keeps shrinking; if it does, worth raising with ILO about IP-based limiting on the gateway's outbound address.

Chronic gateway bug (empty 'Error: ' message from tools/sdmx_tools.py around lines 207-209 catching Exception with an empty str(e)): previously traced on ABS (many occurrences), ESTAT (cycle 1143, 1335, 1365), and ECB (cycle 1337, 1339-adjacent, 1345, 1357). Seen again this run on ABS (cycle 1364) and ESTAT (cycle 1365), both single-cycle and self-resolved. Not fixed by this routine; it only commits to docs/monitor/.

Long-running architectural facts, not incidents: ILO /availableconstraint/ returns 500 (constraints come via ?references=all); ECB does not support /availableconstraint/ (404 is expected, not an error); ESTAT has no practical constraint support; ESTAT direct json check is skipped by design (Eurostat returns 406 for SDMx-JSON); IMF direct json check is skipped by design (IMF ignores the JSON Accept header and returns XML); STATSNZ direct json check is skipped by design (Stats NZ ignores the JSON Accept header and returns CSV); BIS/IMF/ILO references:contentconstraint reads ignored (accepted and silently dropped, seen again this run on ILO); encoding:structure_xml Content-Type charset/version parameter order flips cosmetically from time to time across ABS/FBOS/ILO/SBS/OECD, verdict stays ok as always.
